title: Ashen Delta: The Historian's Tide Ledger
premise: In a marsh where glass reeds record vanished flood levels, the historian must recover lost testimony without rewriting it using a chronicle decoding slate.
ending: Recover the Tide Ledger and return with the unaltered historical account; Delta Ferrymen can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive silt lightning while evading the drowned warden without sacrificing the unaltered historical account.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Delta Ferrymen to witness the chronicle decoding slate.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to reveal a compromising record
